name: @openwop/cli
description: OpenWOP CLI for operating the workflow-engine demo app and OpenWOP-compatible hosts.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/openwop.ts src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outdir=dist --packages=external --banner:js="import { createRequire as _cr } from 'module'; const require = _cr(import.meta.url);"
